changelog:
Initial release — generate native, editable Seewo Whiteboard (.enbx) courseware from lesson outlines or descriptions.

- Accepts free-form lesson topics, outlines, or structured content as input.
- Produces real `.enbx` files (not PPTX), ensuring direct compatibility and editability in the Seewo Whiteboard desktop client.
- Includes scripts for building and validating courseware files for structural integrity.
- Supports convenient auto-layout or explicit control of page layouts and elements.
- Provides clear instructions and validation to ensure results match native Seewo standards.
display_name: Seewo Courseware Generator（希沃白板课件生成）
summary: Generate a multi-page, editable courseware file (.enbx) that opens natively in the Seewo Whiteboard (希沃白板) desktop client, starting only from a topic/outline...
